messages:
marie_ops: Heads-up: planned maintenance for eu-central GPU racks on Tue Apr 14 02:00-04:00 UTC. Scope: NVLink firmware + BMC microcode on 9 racks. We'll do staggered cordon/drain 3 racks at a time, canary first rack, then two waves. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/euc-gpu-firmware

samir_infra: ETA on effective capacity hit? need numbers for autoscaler and customer comms.

marie_ops: Expected steady-state GPU capacity dip ~12% during peak of the window while 3 racks are offline. We'll backfill with reserved pool (dedicated-reserve) and us-west spillover for non-eu tenants. Estimated extra infra cost ~ $1.2k for the full window (egress+burst instances).

carmen_oncall: I'm oncall 02:00-06:00 UTC, I'll own the primary pager. Please add me to the rotation in the runbook and ping @carmen_oncall when the canary completes.

marie_ops: Added. Sequence summary in runbook snippet:

```
# high level
1) cordon nodes in rack-A
2) drain (graceful, wait for 60s for in-flight tok) using `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60`
3) apply NVLink fw + BMC microcode
4) power-cycle controllers (soft), verify health checks
5) uncordon and run canary traffic for 10m
6) if canary ok -> repeat for rack-B/C
```

lucas_sre: Important: model-serving needs KV cache pre-seed to avoid tail latency spike. Plan: after rack-A uncordon, run synthetic prefix-seed against canary replicas:

```
for model in text-gen-1 chat-2 reranker; do
  curl -s -X POST "$CANARY_HOST/v1/seed" -d '{"prompt":"<common prefixes>","tokens":128}'
done
```

lucas_sre: Also schedule a short 5m traffic shift to the canary route (route: eu.prod->eu-canary) instead of full split to exercise routing + KV warmup.

ellen_cost: Can we cap cross-region burst egress? We should avoid accidental multi-region spill that racks into motherboard vm pricing. Suggest setting quota: `egress_daily_limit=200GB` for this maintenance window.

marie_ops: Good call — I've set a temporary egress cap and configured routing preference to favor dedicated-reserve first, then us-west only for best-effort tenants. Fallback policy: if egress cap hit, traffic will fall back to degraded model variant (quantized-8) with routing tag `fallback:cost-saver`.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: eu-central GPU firmware maintenance starting 6172839450 (Tue Apr 14 02:00 UTC). Assigned: marie_ops, carmen_oncall, samir_infra. Window: 2h.

samir_infra: Quick checklist for capacity engineers:
- Freeze automatic bin-packing 30m before window
- Disable aggressive scale-to-zero policies for critical models
- Reserve burst credits for 'dedicated-reserve' pool

carmen_oncall: Noted. I'll monitor the canary and escalate if P50 latency > 250ms or error rate > 1% for 5m.

marie_ops: Last item — customer comms: we'll send a brief advisory to EU-hosted tenants 48h prior and include option to opt into dedicated fallback if they need guaranteed capacity. Draft message in #customer-success later today.

lucas_sre: One more: add a post-maint telemetry check: verify token-per-second, KV hit-rate, and model perf regression against baseline prompts. If regression > 3% open rollback ticket.

ellen_cost: Ack on rollback cost cap: don't auto-roll to us-west if projected cost > $3k for the window. Manual approval required.

marie_ops: Thanks everyone. Final sweep at 01:15 UTC for preflight. Ping here when ready. :thumbsup:

carmen_oncall: Pinged. I'll be on the post-maint verification channel. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Update: maintenance reminder sent to affected tenants 48h before window.
